items.exampleEn: Each student received a paper bookmark with the school's name printed on it.
items.exampleZh: 每位學生都收到一張印有校名的紙書籤。

items.exampleEn: Impressionism began in France in the late nineteenth century.
items.exampleZh: 印象派於十九世紀末在法國興起。

items.exampleEn: Many people laughed at cubism when Picasso first showed his new style.
items.exampleZh: 畢卡索剛推出這種新風格時，很多人都嘲笑立體派。

items.exampleEn: My little brother is too light to lift me on the seesaw.
items.exampleZh: 我弟弟太輕了，玩翹翹板時沒辦法把我翹起來。

items.exampleEn: The film's love story is only a subplot, but many viewers enjoyed it most.
items.exampleZh: 電影裡的愛情故事只是支線劇情，但很多觀眾最喜歡它。

items.exampleEn: Making handicrafts helps my aunt relax after a long day at work.
items.exampleZh: 做手工藝能幫我阿姨在工作一整天後放鬆。

items.exampleEn: The cornet looks like a small trumpet.
items.exampleZh: 短號看起來像一把小喇叭。

items.exampleEn: The temple doors are covered with detailed woodcarving.
items.exampleZh: 那座廟的門上布滿了精細的木雕。

items.sentenceEn: Two children were laughing as they went up and down on the seesaw.
items.sentenceZh: 兩個孩子在翹翹板上一上一下，笑個不停。

items.audioEn: The woodcarving class meets on Saturday mornings, and all the tools are provided.
items.audioZh: 木雕課在星期六早上上課，所有工具都由課程提供。
items.questionZh: 木雕課的工具由誰準備？

items.sentenceEn: I lost my bookmark, so I have no idea which page I was on.
items.sentenceZh: 我的書籤不見了，所以完全不知道讀到哪一頁。

items.sentenceEn: In the school band, my brother plays the cornet.
items.sentenceZh: 在學校樂隊裡，我的兄弟吹短號。

items.stemEn: In the novel, a small ____ about the detective's sister slowly becomes important.
items.stemZh: 小說裡，一段關於偵探的姊妹的次要情節漸漸變得重要。

items.stemEn: Paintings in the style of ____ often show soft light, bright colors and outdoor scenes.
items.stemZh: 印象派風格的畫作常呈現柔和的光線、明亮的色彩和戶外景色。

items.passageEn: Our art club's trip to the city museum was full of surprises. In the first hall, we studied impressionism and saw paintings full of light and color. Next came a room about cubism, where faces and guitars were broken into strange shapes. Downstairs, a handicraft fair was selling cloth bags, a small brass cornet, and beautiful woodcarving from local artists. I bought a leather bookmark shaped like a leaf. On the bus home, our teacher told us that the building was once a toy factory, and the playground behind it still has an old seesaw. I wrote everything down in my diary; it was an exhausting but wonderful day.
items.passageZh: 我們美術社去市立博物館的旅程充滿驚喜。在第一個展廳，我們研究了印象派，看到充滿光與色彩的畫作。接著是立體派展間，裡面的人臉和吉他都被拆成奇怪的形狀。樓下有個手工藝市集，賣布包、一支小黃銅短號，還有在地藝術家的精美木雕。我買了一張葉子形狀的皮革書籤。回程的公車上，老師說這棟建築以前是玩具工廠，後面的遊樂場到現在還有一座舊翹翹板。我把一切都寫進日記，那是累人卻美好的一天。

questions.questionZh: 立體派展間裡的人臉和吉他是什麼樣子？
這棟博物館以前是什麼？

items.promptZh: 這家店賣當地的手工藝品，例如木盒和陶杯。
referenceEn: This shop sells local handicrafts, such as wooden boxes and pottery cups.
The store sells local handicrafts like wooden boxes and pottery cups.
rubricZh: handicraft 指手工藝品，常用複數（例如 local handicrafts）
「例如」可寫 such as、like；時態合理即可（例如 sells、sold）

items.promptZh: 我把這個食譜網站加入書籤，方便以後再找。
referenceEn: I bookmarked this recipe website so I can find it again later.
I've bookmarked this recipe website so that I can find it easily later.
rubricZh: bookmark 當動詞，表示「加入書籤」（例如 bookmarked this website 等）
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 bookmarked、have bookmarked 等）
「方便以後再找」可寫，例如 so I can find it again later 等
